name: Qubits
description: Fundamental quantum state units representing information in linear combinations of |0⟩ and |1⟩ states.

name: Superposition
description: The principle where a qubit exists simultaneously in a linear combination of basis states until measured.

name: Quantum Measurement
description: Observation process that collapses a quantum superposition state probabilistically to a classical basis state.

name: Quantum Gates
description: Unitary linear transformations (such as Hadamard, Pauli-X, CNOT) applied to modify qubit states in a circuit.

name: Entanglement
description: Quantum phenomenon where two or more qubits become correlated such that the state of one instantly determines another.

name: Bell States
description: Specific maximally entangled two-qubit states created using Hadamard and CNOT gates.

name: Quantum Circuits
description: Sequences of quantum gates, state preparation operations, and measurements acting on qubits.

name: Grover's Algorithm
description: Quantum search algorithm providing quadratic speedup for unstructured database lookup using amplitude amplification.

name: Shor's Algorithm
description: Quantum algorithm for integer factorization in polynomial time using quantum phase estimation and order finding.
